description: This file sets up embedded UI static files via Go's embed package and registers HTTP routes for serving a web-based UI using the Gin framework. It includes route handlers for static assets, SPA fallback, and UI initialization checks.

methods.name: RegisterUIRoutes
methods.description: Registers routes with the Gin engine to serve embedded UI static files, handle SPA routing, and redirect root to UI.

methods.name: IsUIEmbedded
methods.description: Checks whether the embedded UI files are available in the binary.
